items.evidence_summary: Official current team page explicitly invites freelance professionals with P.IVA in digital communication, web design, programming, apps, graphics and related specialties to join the Dream Team. Founder Gaia specializes in WordPress. The current homepage verifies the business is based in Milano and works remotely across Italy. No exact authoritative application email was verified; a technical-support address found on a client site is not an application route.
items.why_high_value: Explicit P.IVA freelance network, WordPress-specialized founder, project-based specialist model and nationwide remote operation are highly compatible with VDS agency-overflow collaboration.
verified_facts: Explicit P.IVA freelancer invitation is current on the official team page.
Web design and programming are named target skills.
Official homepage states Milano base and remote work throughout Italy.
inferences: Exact recurring assignment volume is not stated.
No generic or technical-support mailbox is assumed to be the collaboration route.
safe_alternative_angles: Use the official interactive contact route only after owner review, positioning VDS as complementary WordPress/frontend/performance production capacity.
do_not_bypass_constraints: Do not use tecnico@dreambigdesign.it; it is technical support on a client site, not an application route.
Do not guess an application email.
recommended_human_checks: Open the official Contattami route and confirm the intended contact mechanism.
Use only truthful VDS WordPress/frontend/performance evidence.

items.evidence_summary: A public company-authored TIF creativehub post seeks a Web Designer for ecommerce and corporate interfaces with WordPress, Elementor, HTML/CSS, Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud and explicitly directs CV plus portfolio to candidature@tif.agency. The official agency site verifies the organization and Lombardia operating locations. The public signal is roughly 1-3 months old depending on index view, and no freelance/P.IVA contract model is stated.
items.why_high_value: Near-exact WordPress/Elementor/HTML/CSS/UI implementation fit and an explicit candidacy email create a short route to a potentially valuable agency relationship.
verified_facts: TIF creativehub itself published the Web Designer search.
WordPress, Elementor, HTML/CSS, Figma and Adobe are requested.
candidature@tif.agency is explicitly published as the CV/portfolio route.
Official site verifies TIF creativehub and Lombardia presence.
inferences: The role may still be open, but current acceptance is not independently confirmed on an official careers page.
safe_alternative_angles: Owner may review whether a truthful external-freelance/B2B candidacy is appropriate before any contact.
do_not_bypass_constraints: Do not assert freelance/P.IVA compatibility without evidence.
Do not auto-send while contract model/current opening status remains unresolved.
recommended_human_checks: Confirm whether the Web Designer search is still accepting applications.
Verify whether TIF accepts external P.IVA/freelance collaborators for this need.

items.evidence_summary: The official current careers page states there are no open positions today, but continues to collect applications for future opportunities. It explicitly says WP-OK works with external collaborators holding P.IVA/equivalent foreign status and documents previously used long-term WordPress/WooCommerce support, Core Web Vitals/performance and development roles with 40-60 hours/month. The form remains active for future consideration and asks rate, availability and technical WordPress/CWV questions.
items.why_high_value: Exceptional technical overlap with VDS: WordPress, WooCommerce, Elementor, PHP/CSS/JS, hosting/Cloudflare, support and Core Web Vitals, plus explicit external-P.IVA and long-term recurring collaboration model.
verified_facts: Future applications are explicitly collected through the official form.
External collaborators with P.IVA/equivalent foreign status are explicitly the contract model.
Closed WordPress roles offered long-term 40-60 hours/month collaboration.
inferences: A new WordPress opening may recur, but no current vacancy can be claimed.
safe_alternative_angles: Owner may choose to enter the future-opportunities talent pool manually; otherwise monitor for a reopened WordPress role.
do_not_bypass_constraints: Do not describe any closed WordPress role as currently open.
Do not substitute a generic company email for the official form.
Do not invent hourly rate or availability.
recommended_human_checks: Decide whether to submit a future-opportunity application now or monitor for reopening.
If applying manually, use owner-approved rate/availability and attachment policy.
